preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the logical scheme is between 2 and 1,000,000 (inclusive).

Each of the next n lines contains a valid description of a vertex: type ('AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT', 'IN') followed by either a bit value (0 or 1) for 'IN' or indices of input vertices for logical elements.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 or len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each 'IN' vertex has exactly one token (type + bit), 'NOT' has three tokens (type + one input index), and 'AND', 'OR', 'XOR' have three tokens (type + two input indices).

preconditions.expression: all(int(idx) >= 1 and int(idx) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for idx in line.split()[1:] if idx.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All vertex indices referenced in the input are valid (between 1 and n).

preconditions.expression: all(int(bit) in {0, 1} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'IN')
preconditions.description: All 'IN' vertices have a bit value of either 0 or 1.
The graph is a valid undirected tree with root at vertex 1, where all leaves (excluding root) are 'IN' vertices, and all other vertices are logical elements ('AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT').

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == count_inputs(stdin) and all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output is a string of '0's and '1's, one character per input vertex in ascending order of their indices.

postconditions.expression: all(flip_input_and_compute(stdin, i, bit) == int(stdout[i-1]) for i, bit in enumerate(get_input_bits(stdin), 1))
postconditions.description: For each input vertex i, the output character at position i-1 is the result of flipping the bit of input i (from its original value to 1 - original) and computing the output of the scheme (vertex 1).
